observations: Photo 0 shows two car headlight assemblies, likely for a front-left and front-right side, placed on a concrete floor.
The headlights have a clear lens with visible internal reflectors and bulb housings.
The housing appears to be black plastic with some silver or chrome trim around the lens.
There is a watermark 'STANLY AUTO SOLUTION' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on the image.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlights themselves.
The headlights appear to be in used condition with some smudges and reflections on the lens.

claims.evidence: No visible branding or model identifiers on the headlights in photo 0. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the image alone.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The headlights may not be for a Honda CR-V 2004 or may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the model number or part number on the back or side of the headlights, or a photo of the headlights installed on a CR-V 2004.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used headlights, not as CR-V 2004 parts

risks.risk: The headlights may be cracked, fogged, or have internal damage not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens and internal components, including the bulb sockets and reflectors, to check for cracks or fogging.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged or non-functional

risks.risk: The headlights may not be compatible with the buyer's vehicle due to size or mounting differences.
risks.proof: A photo showing the back of the headlights with mounting points and a comparison to the buyer's vehicle's headlights.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incompatible or requiring modification

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or battery showing the brand and model, usually on the hood or door.
Clear photo of the back or side of the headlights showing any model or part numbers.
Close-up photo of the lens and internal components to check for cracks or fogging.
Photo showing the headlights installed on a CR-V 2004 or a comparison to the buyer's vehicle.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
